reference.note: This is recorded evidence for Rust tests. Cargo does not invoke the pristine executable.

M01.basis: Pristine tbl_data.c::getdata follows previous data rows in the current column, and a whole-row rule has no predecessor cell to continue. tbl_cdata distinguishes a missing payload from an authored empty text line. The ManT test fixes this ownership without requiring an upstream layout result on the unguarded path.

matrix.witness: All freshly recorded profiles contain BEFORE, UPPER, LOWER and AFTER exactly once and in order.

assertions: upper owner payload and text-block flag
unique sentinels in ASCII, UTF-8 and HTML
JSON round trip and IR validation
two-row span and empty owner/continuation blocks
ordered unique reading sentinels in native projection and Markdown readback
continuation marker absent from visible text

matrix.withheld: An exact matrix row labeled withheld-null-owner-path was not run against the pristine executable. Historical signal statuses below use independently hashed audit inputs. No historical status is assigned to different bytes.

assertions: row owner spans 2 columns and 3 rows
reading order and copy at 24/80 columns
same source column in wide layout
continuedOwnerControl.basis: The adjacent source has one CELL row in T{}; its span topology establishes the comparison. The empty source is exercised only by the fixed product.

priorAudit.provenance: broad-review-80afb34c under target/audits, snapshot and SHA256 as recorded above. The historical reference used its default locale and rendering width.
priorAudit.interpretation: A negative exit is a recorded signal. Null means the audit did not run that profile. Prior inputs are supplemental audit evidence, not fresh product regression assertions.

limits: This record does not attach TUI or sanitizer results to the exact matrix, or coverage for two consecutive down rows.

M04.basis: Pinned read.c dispatches ROFF_SO to mparse_open, which uses its working directory and retries a .gz suffix. The descriptor and lexical boundaries of IncludePolicy::Root are ManT policy.

matrix.sourceBinding: sourceCaseId indexes nativeSources.rows, which also binds the included file bytes.

nativeSources.witness: The native CLI read TARGETWORD between before and after from the corresponding source directory or tree root. It has no IncludePolicy::Root setting.

rootPolicy.interpretation: Native CLI Root policy comparison is not applicable.
rows: included nested markers exactly once in order
surrounding body and include diagnostic, no target marker
surrounding body and include diagnostic, no target marker

gzip.hashScope: Exact decoded roff sources, independently of gzip headers.

priorAudit.provenance: broad-review-80afb34c under target/audits, input/root-controls.json. The historical diagnostic-enabled invocation reported a missing qualified pathname when run from the source directory.

limits: This records Linux outcomes. Windows reparse and other platform behaviors were not run.
The virtual bundle and ambient-cwd controls are linked product tests, not native Root oracle cases.

M05.basis: read.c strips a file-start BOM. roff.c::roff_getcontrol recognizes the default control spellings and skips horizontal whitespace. roff_parse_comment runs before request lookup. Static recognition does not authorize or resolve a pathname.

matrix.witness: All four profiles render UNIQUE_TARGET_BODY exactly once for each standalone request.

assertions: target title and single paragraph body

recognizerControls.interpretation: Native exits record execution independently. A zero exit does not prove the source is a safe standalone alias.

limits: The positive test asserts source identity, target and body. It does not assert the exact diagnostic list for each positive.
Missing targets and filesystem authorization are separate from this lexical oracle.
